The dashboard now pre-renders its heading and placeholders for all three widgets. Each widget waits behind a `Suspense` boundary, while the shared data fetch is deduplicated per request. The route-level loading view uses the same shell, and partial prefetching is enabled.

`npm run build` passed. Next.js reports `/` as a partially pre-rendered route, and the generated HTML contains the heading and widget placeholders. Live data rendering remains unverified because the app points to `https://api.example.com/dashboard`.
